vendored_fork_assessment: minimal + correct. Byte-diffed third_party/charmbracelet-x-vt-racefix against the pinned module cache (v0.0.0-20260519012233-798e623c8447): the ONLY source difference is emulator.go — `closed bool` -> `closed atomic.Bool` (import + comment), with all 3 field accesses converted (2 Load, 1 CompareAndSwap replacing the old read-then-write in Close). The CAS is semantically identical AND strictly strengthens Close() idempotency (old code had a two-caller TOCTOU calling CloseWithError twice; CAS guarantees exactly one). go.mod and go.sum are byte-identical to upstream (module path intact). Only 2 files removed (emulator_test.go, scrollback_test.go) — test-only, as claimed; NOT a broader fork. The suspicious `// SKIP: Fix typecheck errors` in osc.go line 2 is PRE-EXISTING UPSTREAM (confirmed present in the module cache copy), not injected. The replace is scoped, pinned to a local dir, and documented with a removal condition in the go.mod comment. CONCERN (minor, non-blocking): a go.mod `replace` FREEZES the module at the local copy — a future version-constraint bump silently has no effect while the replace exists, and `go get -u` will not pull an upstream fix. The removal follow-up is captured in PROSE (decisions.json + go.mod comment) but is NOT a tracked ROADMAP backlog item; recommend adding one so the divergence is actively revisited.
toctou_fix_verdict: sound (4 sites, no new race, no RD-26 regression). Verified all 4 call sites (handleCanUseTool, RequestPermission, requestAskAnswer, requestPlanResponse) call registerPermWaiter(permID) AFTER minting permID but BEFORE any broadcast/publish, and thread the SAME buffered(cap 1) channel into awaitPermission. awaitPermission no longer registers — it only selects on the passed channel + the 15-min fallback (which still deletes by permID). registerPermWaiter and all Answer*/timeout deletes are under a.mu, so no new race. Answer* delivery is lookup+delete-under-lock then a single non-blocking send into the cap-1 channel, so exactly-once delivery is preserved — no resurface, RD-26 intact (TestBashPerm_Deny's 'second prompt after deny' assertion unchanged and passing). No early-return between registerPermWaiter and awaitPermission at any site (only best-effort `if ...; err==nil` inline broadcasts), so no waiter-map leak. Replay path (client_overlap_replay_test.go) only had a gofmt whitespace change and passes.
no_test_weakening: confirmed. `grep -rn t.Skip/Skipf` across the 4 touched packages shows only PRE-EXISTING env-gated smoke skips (survival_gate, real_incus, real-claude spike, symlink-unsupported fixtures) — none added by this sprint. The diff's 'skip' hits are: prose in decisions/verification JSON, the `skipLive` GC parameter name, a testutil comment explicitly stating a widened budget is NOT a skip, and the upstream osc.go comment. Adaptive timeout only widens (multiplier>=1, scale>=1, default 1). Every assertion in the 3 perm test files is unchanged (diff shows only `2*time.Second` -> `permTestTimeout(2*time.Second)`). The leak fix (t.Errorf on survivor/pgrep) and idempotency pins (exactly-N pkill shape) are real, added assertions — coverage grew, not shrank.
